name: Crunchbase
requirements: Free registered account required to add or edit profiles.
Registered users must additionally complete social authentication (connect LinkedIn/Facebook/Twitter, or Google) before adding profiles.
Search first — if the company already has an auto-generated profile, claim/edit it instead of creating a duplicate.
Company profile tone: 3rd person, no marketing language ('best', 'most comprehensive'), no dating language ('new' → 'launched April 2008').
preparation: Registered account (email or Google/LinkedIn) + at least one connected social account for authentication.
Founded date; headquarters location (use a business/registered address, not a home address).
Website URL and social media links.
Short and long company descriptions (3rd person).
Founders, funding rounds, employees/board/advisors details for completeness.
workflow: Register at crunchbase.com (Log In → Register tab) or via Google One Tap.
Complete social authentication in Account Settings.
Search for the company; if a profile exists use 'Claim'/Edit via Actions menu.
Otherwise: Resources → Create Profile (or /add-new) → select Company → enter details → 'Save All Edits'.
Fill overview fields (logo, website, socials, founded date, HQ, industries, founders, funding) to maximize Crunchbase Rank.
watchFor: Social authentication is a hard gate — a bare email registration cannot add profiles.
Profiles are editable by the community — monitor for unwanted edits.
Marketing language violates guidelines and can be reverted.
Paid subscriptions exist but are NOT required for a basic profile — avoid upgrade prompts.
Contact email may be publicly visible depending on settings.
countsAsLive: A public crunchbase.com/organization/<slug> page reachable while logged out, showing the company overview fields.
unknowns: Whether new profiles go through any moderation delay before being publicly visible.
Current list of accepted social-auth providers.
